title: Initial discovery & technical sync — ClearBridge.ai
text:
Initial discovery & technical sync — ClearBridge.ai

['From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Liu <h.liu@clearbridge.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbridge.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed times for discovery & tech sync

Hi Hannah / Samir —

Thanks for the interest in Redwood. Quick intro: I’m Marissa (AE) and I’ll run the kickoff and commercial side. I’ve CC’d Dev (SE) and Rishi (solutions) so we have engineering coverage.

Goal: 45–60m discovery to understand ClearBridge.ai’s integration needs (inference scale, data flows, security/comms needs) and confirm who needs to join from your side for a later demo.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue 2026-09-29, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2026-09-30, 14:00–15:00
- Thu 2026-10-01, 08:30–09:30

If procurement or security need to join the first call, happy to include a short 10–15m slot at the end for them — otherwise we can loop them post-call with the MAP.

Please reply with your preferred slot and who will be the technical lead on your side. Also, if you have a short security questionnaire we should see before the call, send it over (we’ll attach SOC2 and an engineer-friendly architecture summary).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference
', 'From: Hannah Liu <h.liu@clearbridge.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbridge.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed times for discovery & tech sync

Thanks Marissa — excited to start. Samir (our engineering lead) will be the technical owner. He’s available Wed 14:00–15:00 PT, that slot works best.

One note on attendees: I’ll invite our procurement rep (procurement@clearbridge.ai) and our security contact (alin.security@clearbridge.ai). They may join for the tail end — procurement usually only needs high-level T&Cs and pricing/engagement timeline. Security asked if you could share your SOC2 report and a short list of what data would be processed/stored by Redwood.

Also attaching our short security questionnaire now (security-questionnaire_clearbridge.docx) so your team can triage before the call.

Hannah Liu
Senior Product Manager, ClearBridge.ai
h.liu@clearbridge.ai
', 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Liu <h.liu@clearbridge.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbridge.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@clearbridge.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed times for discovery & tech sync

Perfect — wed 2026-09-30 14:00 PT is penciled. I’ve attached our SOC2 summary and an initial mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines typical owners and next steps so procurement has a sense of timing. Dev / Rishi — could you review the questionnaire attached and flag any items we should pre-answer before Wed?

Attachments: SOC2-Redwood-Inference.pdf, mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx

Agenda (30–45m technical + 15m procurement/security Q&A):
1) 10m — Introductions & success criteria (Marissa)
2) 20m — Architecture & requirements (Samir + Dev)
3) 10–15m — Procurement/security questions & next steps

If anyone prefers a different meeting length, say so — otherwise we’ll plan for a 60m invite.

Thanks — looking forward.

Marissa
', 'From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Liu <h.liu@clearbridge.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbridge.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed times for discovery & tech sync

Thanks — I reviewed the questionnaire. A few quick notes I’ll flag in the answers doc:
- We do not persist customer prompt text in logs by default; KV cache is encrypted and retention is configurable.
- SSO: we support OIDC + SAML; please share your IdP metadata if you want an SSO pre-check.
- Network: we support VPC peering and private endpoints for private deployments; hosted API has region-based endpoints.

Samir — quick Q for the call: do you want us to prepare a short diagram of the recommended integration flow (inference path + data classification) or is a high-level discussion OK for the first call? If you want the diagram, I can send a 1-slide architecture ahead of the meeting.

On Wed 14:00 PT I can join for the full hour.

—Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
', 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Liu <h.liu@clearbridge.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbridge.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@clearbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed times for discovery & tech sync

Great — invite sent for Wed, Sep 30 2026 14:00–15:00 PT (Zoom). Calendar invite includes: agenda, dial-in + meeting notes doc (shared Drive link), and the attachments we discussed.

Action items before the call:
- Dev: one-slide architecture (optional) — please upload to the shared Drive by Tue EOD.
- Marissa (me): confirm MAP owners and pricing range for procurement.
- Hannah: confirm whether security will join the full call or the tail end.

If procurement prefers a separate 15–20m slot later in the week for commercial specifics, I can schedule that after the call — otherwise we’ll cover the high-level items at the end.

See you Wednesday.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
']
